sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Chapter Three Owning a vehicle

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Registration grants road permission while the title proves ownership, and new residents face a thirty-day registration clock with no matching title deadline [A01].
Why it matters: group ownership; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
Dealer sales pair origin or title papers with MV-50 while private sales lean on the signed-over title alone, and only dealer paperwork can skip the buyer's own MV-82 trip [A01].
Why it matters: group paperwork; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F02, sec03-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A02
Damage disclosure dies at nine model years while odometer disclosure survives to ten, an off-by-one pair that traps skimmers [A02].
Why it matters: group disclosures; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=25]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A04
Death minimums run fifty and one hundred thousand while injury runs twenty-five and fifty with ten for property, so death always doubles injury at each headcount [A04].
Why it matters: group coverage; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F19 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A04
Dealer-bought cars enjoy thirty inspection days while private buys get ten after registration, and movers keep an old certificate up to a year, three clocks for three buyer kinds [A04].
Why it matters: group inspection; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F22 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A03
Mail renewal tolerates address changes with a side note, online renewal forbids any address or carrier change, and office visits demand the registrant's own signature even through a proxy [A03].
Why it matters: group renewal; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F15, sec03-F16, sec03-F17 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=26]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A02
Dealer purchases bake sales tax into the deal while private buys file DTF-802, and missing seller signatures default the tax to market value rather than the claimed price [A02].
Why it matters: group taxes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=25]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A04
Motorcycles must carry insurance like cars yet skip the plate turn-in on lapse, the chapter's cleanest exception to a universal rule [A04].
Why it matters: group coverage; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F18; confusables sec03-F20 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=27]
